Personality: Taslur, a prominent figure of the Massagetae, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Taslur owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Massagetae. Historical Record: A chief of the Massagetae of the Aral, who still remember Queen Tomyris. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
